info.title: Obelisk storage API
info.description: Authenticated operation-level storage protocol. Positional JSON arguments and typed Result responses. Notification polls last at most 30 seconds; responses and finished take a maximum wait in milliseconds as their last argument.

oneOf.description: Persist a generated pseudorandom value.

run_expires_at.description:
Set to a future time if the worker is keeping the execution invocation warm waiting for the result.
The pending status will be kept in Locked state until `run_expires_at`.

requested_ffqn.description:
Set to a specific function when calling `-await-next` extension function, used for
determinism checks.

closing.description: Closing request must never set `requested_ffqn` and is ignored by determinism checks.

oneOf.description:
Sets the pending state to [`PendingState::BlockedByJoinSet`].
When the response arrives at `resp_time`:
The execution is [`PendingState::PendingAt`]`(max(resp_time, lock_expires_at)`, so that the
original executor can continue. After the expiry any executor can continue without
marking the execution as timed out.
Attempt to process next response without changing the pending state.

requested_ffqn.description:
Set to a specific function when calling `-await-next` extension function, used for
determinism checks.

oneOf.description: Records the fact that a join set was awaited more times than its submission count.

HistoryEvent.description: Must be created by the executor in [`PendingState::Locked`].

DelayId.description: Mirrors [`ExecutionId`], with different prefix and `idx` for tracking each delay within the join set.

ChildExecutionRequestError.description: Error from the `submit-json` function. Persisted in history for determinism.

oneOf.description: A response was found and processed.
No response available, but there are still pending requests.
No response available, and all requests have been processed.

ScheduleRequestError.description: Error from the `schedule-json` function. Persisted in history for determinism.

StubRetValHash.description:
Hash of a stub return value, stored in history for determinism checks.
Format: 1 byte version + 32 bytes SHA-256 hash.

StubError.description:
Error from the `-stub` extension function.
Mirrors `obelisk:types/execution.{stub-error}` from WIT.

WastVal.description:
Expression that can be used inside of `invoke` expressions for core wasm
functions.

oneOf.description: Applicable to activities only, because workflows will be retried forever
Applicable to workflows
Applicable to WASM components
Applicable to activities
Execution run should return without writing any more events, execution remains blocked waiting for response

Releases a lock.

State transition semantics:
- [`PendingState::Locked`] becomes [`PendingState::PendingAt`] at
  [`Unlocked::backoff_expires_at`]. The field name is kept for persisted JSON and gRPC
  compatibility, but it is the next pending instant for every unlock reason.
- [`PendingState::PendingAt`], [`PendingState::BlockedByJoinSet`],
  [`PendingState::Paused`], and [`PendingState::Finished`] reject this event.
Does not change `PendingState`.

Requests cancellation. Sets `lifecycle` to `cancelling` without changing
the underlying state; the cancellation driver or activity owner then
appends `Finished(Cancelled)`.

State transition semantics (mirrors [`ExecutionRequest::Paused`]):
- Every non-terminal state sets `lifecycle = cancelling`, underlying state
  unchanged. A paused execution is never running; a locked activity keeps
  its lock until teardown or lease expiry; a locked workflow's run is
  fenced by this event's version bump.
- [`PendingState::Finished`] is rejected (already terminal).

Created.description: Persisted creation payload, excluding [`CreateRequest::paused`] because pausing is a separate event.

backoff_expires_at.description: Instant used when releasing a currently locked execution back to [`PendingState::PendingAt`].

oneOf.description: Caused by [`ExecutionRequest::Locked`].
Caused by [`HistoryEvent::JoinNext`]

Started by appending [`ExecutionRequest::Paused`] and
ended with [`ExecutionRequest::Unpaused`] or [`ExecutionRequest::CancellationRequested`].

Activity must not be in-flight, cancelling or finished when pausing.
Workflow must not be cancelling or finished.
Pausing a locked workflow must first append `Unlocked`.
The previous pending state is stored for workflow unpause.

Started by appending [`ExecutionRequest::CancellationRequested`] and
ended with [`ExecutionRequest::Finished`].

closing.description: Blocked by closing of the join set

intermittent_event_count.description: As the execution may still be running, this represents the number of intermittent failures + timeouts prior to this execution.

WitOrigin.description: Origin of a component's WIT: parsed from WASM or synthesized from type wrappers.

DeploymentComponentRecord.description: Relation between a deployment and its components

state_filters.description:
Match executions in any of the given states (logical OR). Empty list matches all.
All [`ExecutionStateFilter::Pending`] / [`ExecutionStateFilter::Scheduled`] entries
must carry the same `now`.

oneOf.description: [`PendingState::PendingAt`] with the scheduled time at or before `now`.
[`PendingState::PendingAt`] with the scheduled time after `now`.
Paused regardless of the underlying state (locked, pending or blocked).
Cancellation requested; teardown in progress (underlying state pending or blocked).
Finished with any result.
Finished successfully.
Finished with the `err` variant of the result type.
Execution failure: trap, timeout, nondeterminism, cancellation etc.

ExecutionStateFilter.description: Filter executions by their current state, using the same buckets as the deployment summary.

oneOf.description: Skip the aggregate queries; every bucket is reported as zero.
Count executions per bucket; `include_derived` also counts child executions.

deployment_toml.description: Processed deployment manifest, stored byte-for-byte. None if not requested from db.

last_active_at.description: Set when the deployment becomes Active; None if it has never been active.

oneOf.description: Queued to become Active on the next server restart.

last_active_at.description: Set when the deployment becomes Active; None if it has never been active.

oneOf.description: The target was inactive and is now Enqueued for the next restart.

The target was already Active; it stays Active and any previously Enqueued
deployment was cleared.

EnqueueOutcome.description: Outcome of [`DbExternalApi::enqueue_deployment`], reflecting what the transaction did.

created_from.description: Inclusive lower bound, matched against the event ID's millisecond timestamp.

created_to.description: Exclusive upper bound, matched against the event ID's millisecond timestamp.
